addons.author: Toni_Carter_Company_Mods_Inc
addons.notes: Sole radio mod in Long Haul Legacy 2.0 (Flaton's walkie-talkie removed). Frequency-tuned (100.0-999.9 MHz) Simple Voice Chat radios with radio audio effects, squelch, /walkie, /radio, and text channel support. Preconfigured in overrides/config/walkietalkies-server.properties; early Chapter 01 quest + /lh radio kit grant starter radios dynamically when loaded.
